Gold.note: Central bank buying and macro hedging support elevated prices.

Silver.note: Industrial solar demand and monetary premium drive outperformance.

Copper.note: Structural supply deficits and grid electrification demand remain robust.

Uranium.note: Long-term utility contracting and primary supply deficits support strong upside.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and moderating EV growth rates pressure prices.

Nickel.note: Persistent Indonesian supply surplus and LFP battery substitution weigh on outlook.

Zinc.note: Tight mine supply and low smelter treatment charges support producer margins.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness offsets resilient infrastructure steel demand.

Coal.note: Long-term energy transition headwinds despite near-term Asian demand resilience.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks are offset by soft near-term EV and wind turbine demand.

Manganese.note: Stable steel production provides a neutral baseline for battery-grade demand.

PGM.note: Structural decline in internal combustion engine volumes pressures auto-catalyst demand.

Potash.note: Steady global agricultural application rates and normalized supply chains support pricing.

Aluminum.note: Capacity caps in China and rising green-energy demand tighten the supply balance.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to both bullish base metals and defensive precious metals.
